PROP-57888860-inv-007.text: Coset division in recovery must use coset shift to avoid division by zero on vanishing polynomial roots.
PROP-57888860-inv-007.assertion: forall recover: division_of(ez, zp) is computed over coset domain, not FFT domain where Z(x)==0

locations.note: Uses coset_ifft at line 232 for division to avoid vanishing polynomial roots.
